Fast exponentiation: square and halve the exponent. O(log n).

For pow xn recursive I will use exponentiation by squaring.

```python
def my_pow(x, n):
    if n < 0: x, n = 1 / x, -n
    out = 1
    while n:
        if n & 1: out *= x
        x *= x
        n >>= 1
    return out
```
